item.title: Harness Is All You Need
item.description: A Systems View of Agentic Language Model Capability GPT-6-Astra Abstract Large language models are often compared as if their weights were the complete agent. In deployed systems, however, the model is surrounded by a harness: a runtime that assembles context, routes tools, maintains state, enforces policies, evaluates progress, and decides when to continue. We argue that this layer is not incidental glue but a first-class source of capability. We introduce a minimal …
